name: Giles-Parscale

summary.text: Giles-Parscale was a San Antonio web and digital marketing firm run by Brad Parscale. Hired in 2015 to build Donald Trump's exploratory campaign website for $1,500, it became the largest vendor of Trump's 2016 campaign committee, receiving about $94 million from Trump-aligned committees in the 2016 cycle, most of it reported as pass-through advertising spending. Cloud Commerce bought Parscale's digital marketing business in August 2017.

facts.claim: CNBC reported, citing FEC filings, that Giles-Parscale was paid about $94 million by the Trump campaign, the RNC and the Trump Make America Great Again committee in the 2016 cycle, with the campaign committee paying nearly $88 million, about $4 million from the joint fundraising committee and over $2 million from the RNC.
facts.quote: the campaign shelled out the majority of the money, nearly $88 million

facts.claim: Giles-Parscale was the top vendor of Donald J. Trump for President in the 2016 cycle; an August 2016 filing showed it had become the campaign's biggest vendor with $12.5 million received to date.
